Metadata.title: MASC 2026 — SUPERNOVA
Metadata.description: Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026: SUPERNOVA — Vietnam’s arena for the next generation of marketing talent.

hero.eyebrow: Kotler Klub - VinUni House of Marketers
hero.description: Push past your personal limits and create a completely new legacy in marketing.

about.title: A new legacy forged through breakthrough.
about.lead: Marketing All-Star Challenge (MASC) is an exclusive national marketing competition hosted by Kotler Klub — VinUni House of Marketers.
about.description: Inspired by the supernova phenomenon, this year's Supernova theme symbolizes rebirth and breakthrough innovation. It is where top talent pushes past existing limits to create a completely new legacy.
about.caption: Not resting on past laurels. MASC 2026 is the arena for marketers ready to push their boundaries and shape the future.

prizes.overline: For the teams that outshine the rest
prizes.title: Breakthrough effort deserves a stellar reward.
prizes.poolDescription: Cash prizes, partner benefits, and career opportunities designed to carry winning ideas beyond the competition.
prizes.grandDescription: Awarded to the MASC 2026 Champion — the team that conquers the dual challenge and demonstrates outstanding real-world execution.
prizes.secondDescription: Recognizing sharp strategic insight, breakthrough creativity, and exceptional execution capabilities.
prizes.impactDescription: Celebrating the campaign that creates the strongest positive impact for society and the community.

eligibility.title: The arena for top marketing talent.
eligibility.description: Open to young adults aged 18–22 living and studying in Vietnam who are passionate about marketing and aspiring to pursue a marketing career.
eligibility.achieverDescription: High achievers in prestigious academic Marketing and Business case competitions (Champion, Runner-up, Top 20-50...).
eligibility.leaderDescription: Executive board members of Marketing or Business student clubs at universities.
eligibility.marketerDescription: Finalists/advanced candidates in corporate Management Trainee or Key Talent programs, or Top 50 in MASC'26 Round 0.5.

journey.title: The Journey to Supernova
journey.description: Explore the comprehensive stages and rounds of Marketing All-Star Challenge 2026.

round05.title: Round 0.5: The First Light
round05.summary: An open track for newcomers and teams without a full all-star lineup.
round05.detail: The top 2 teams advance directly to Round 2. The top 50 bypass CV screening into Round 1 and receive exclusive access to case-review sessions and industry sharing sessions.

round1.title: Round 1: The Star Gathering
round1.summary: Three specialized tracks: Product & Growth, Societal + PR, Market Research + Trade.
round1.detail: Teams tackle specialized challenges from Mentor partners allocated on a first-come, first-served basis, with 1-on-1 mentor feedback. The top 2 teams from each track (6 teams total) advance to Round 2.

round2.title: Round 2: The Stellar Forge
round2.summary: The top 6 teams tackle the Diamond Sponsor's societal & cultural challenge.
round2.detail: Solutions must strictly balance breakthrough creativity, real-world feasibility, and positive community impact. The top 4 teams advance to the Real-World Execution Round.

round3.title: The Cosmic Crash
round3.summary: The top 4 execute live marketing campaigns in the real market.
round3.detail: Teams develop proposals into actual live media campaigns with guidance from Mentors and Brand Partners. All 4 teams secure their place in the Grand Finale Pitching Night.

round4.title: Grand Finale: The Infinite Glow
round4.summary: Networking Night (Oct 16), Final Pitching & Dual-Challenge Mini Case (Oct 17).
round4.detail: Top 4 defend their live campaign results before judges. The top 2 teams solve a surprise Mini Case live on stage under time pressure to determine the MASC'26 Champion.

criteria.title: What the judges will look for.
criteria.round1Description: Choose one of three specialized tracks (Product & Growth, Societal + PR/MarCom, Market Research + Trade) and refine your solution through 1-on-1 mentor feedback.
criteria.round2Description: Solve the Diamond Sponsor's challenge by balancing breakthrough creativity, practical application, and meaningful positive community impact.
criteria.finaleDescription: Defend live executed campaign results before the judges, then Top 2 solve an unseen Mini Case live on stage under real-time pressure.

mentors.title: Guided by leading industry experts.
mentors.description: Meet distinguished leaders and experts from top brands, agencies, and corporations bringing real-world expertise directly to this year's contestants.
